current_design_state.layout_type: multi-workspace technical workstation with left sidebar controls and centered canvas viewport
current_design_state.theme: pure monochrome B/W minimalism — zero colorful gradients, zero pastel accents
identified_tells_or_flaws: App.tsx is 1222 lines with deeply nested callbacks — needs extraction to hooks before adding 4 new feature domains
ControlPanel.tsx is 797 lines — adding 5+ new slider sections pushes toward 1000+ lines; should split into sub-components
canvas-renderer.ts is only 92 lines but pixel-by-pixel nested loop; adding saturation/hue/sharpness/bg-removal risks O(n²) perf blowup
VideoStreamingEngine sets video.muted=true — audio passthrough must use WebAudio API MediaElementSourceNode without violating autoplay policy
WebGPU/WebGL renderers in src/lib/renderers/ are dead code — App.tsx always uses Canvas 2D paintAsciiToCanvas()
No background removal exists — no body-segmentation, luminance-threshold, or chroma-key logic
No audio output path — Python backend has ffplay but frontend has zero WebAudio usage
Signal adjustments limited to: contrast, brightness, gamma, columns — no saturation, sharpness, hue, or edge detection
Tauri CSP restricts connect-src — external ML CDN for body-segmentation would violate CSP; must use bundled WASM or threshold heuristic

audio_pipeline_audit.current_state: VideoStreamingEngine sets video.muted=true. No WebAudio API. No audio output. Python backend has ffplay but not integrated with frontend.
audio_pipeline_audit.needed: WebAudio MediaElementSourceNode from video element → AudioContext → Destination. Keep video.muted=true for autoplay compliance.

rendering_pipeline_audit.gpu_renderers_available: WebGPU (src/lib/renderers/webgpu.ts) and WebGL (src/lib/renderers/webgl.ts) exist but are DEAD CODE — never instantiated
rendering_pipeline_audit.procedural_engine: StreamPipeline + renderProcedural3D() with z-buffer in procedural-3d.ts
rendering_pipeline_audit.performance_baseline: ~38 FPS on desktop, ~17.6MB memory, 100×45 grid default

recommendations_for_feature_addition: Extract App.tsx 1222 lines into custom hooks: useVideoEngine(), useAudioEngine(), useSignalAdjustments(), useBackgroundRemoval()
Split ControlPanel.tsx into sub-components: SignalControls, BackgroundRemovalControls, AudioControls, ExportControls
Add saturation/hue/sharpness to canvas-renderer.ts BEFORE background removal — these are simpler pixel transforms
Background removal: use luminance-threshold heuristic (not ML body-segmentation) to avoid CSP violations in Tauri; add tolerance slider
Audio passthrough: create AudioContext in video-pipeline.ts, use MediaElementSourceNode from HTMLVideoElement, route to destination
Do NOT resurrect dead WebGPU/WebGL renderers for signal processing — Canvas2D is sufficient for per-pixel transforms at 100×45 grid scale
Preserve existing workspace isolation — new features must work per-workspace without cross-contamination
